events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Early Trade
events.description: Indian shares clung to modest gains in early trade on Thursday, adding to recent string of gains amid easing crude oil prices and continued foreign fund inflows.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is extending its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling well below the 9,150 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Higher
events.description: Asian markets are trading mostly higher on Thursday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with the semiconductor and technology stocks continuing to rebound amid reports of strong results from the sector and optimism about AI trade. Market sentiment also improved on fading concerns about the re-escalation in the Middle East crisis.

events.title: Indian Shares Likely To Open On Muted Note After Recent Rally
events.description: Indian shares look set to open on a muted note on Thursday as investors react to mixed Asian cues, reports of executive turmoil at Nvidia and the results of MSCI's November review.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Thai Stock Market
events.description: The Thai stock market has tracked higher in three straight sessions, advancing more than 35 points or 2.5 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,500-point plateau and it's expected to open to the upside again on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Modestly Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is trading modestly higher on Thursday, extending the gains in the previous three sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving well above the 61,400 level, with gains in index heavyweights and exporter stocks, while most other sectors are trading mixed.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Reverse Wednesday's Losses
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Wednesday ended the five-day winning streak in which it had spiked almost 220 points or 4.5 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,115-point plateau although it's likely to rebound again on Thursday.

events.title: Rebound Anticipated For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market headed south again on Wednesday, one day after snapping the two-day slide in which it had dropped more than 350 points or 1.4 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,315-point plateau although it may bounce higher again on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Australian market is trading notably lower on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 9,100 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: Continued Strength Expected For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market has moved higher in three straight trading days, gathering almost 30 points or 0.8 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,680-point plateau and it's tipped to extend its gains on Thursday.

events.title: Tech Shares May Fuel Continued Strength For Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has climbed higher in three straight sessions, accelerating almost 3,550 points or 8.6 percent in that span. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 44,250-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green again on Thursday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Reclaim 5,300-Point Level
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished higher in two straight sessions, collecting more than 110 points or 2.1 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now sits just beneath the 5,290-point plateau and it's got another solid lead for Thursday's trade.

events.title: Japan Producer Prices Jump 0.7% In October
events.description: Producer prices in Japan were up 0.7 percent on month in October, the Bank of Japan said on Thursday.
